analysis: KCC r=0.734 vs our rho=0.42 discrepancy investigation
conclusion: KCC r=0.734 was an OS-eye-only analysis (n=42), not bilateral

kcc_reproduction.note: r=0.734 reproduces exactly for OS-only (n=42). KCC reported this as if bilateral.

head_to_head_same_51_OS_eyes.explanation: Same patients, same VF dates (96%), but different GCL extraction pipeline

paper_narrative: The previously reported r=0.734 was computed from OS eyes only (n=42), not bilaterally. Our analysis uses all 276 eyes (bilateral LME with random patient intercept). On the identical 51 overlapping OS eyes, KCC GCL values yield r=0.722 vs our reextracted GCL r=0.355, indicating that the GCL OCR pipeline difference (MAE=5.3 um) also contributes substantially. Our bilateral approach with standardized GCL extraction provides a more rigorous estimate (rho=0.42-0.52).
